description: The CPU walk against this GPU's walk, ray for ray: Sponza primary and air rays (default merged quantized scene and instanced f32), shared-edge rays plain and transformed, the oracle's random cases. Any hits must agree everywhere, closest hits never disagree on hit or miss, primary rays name the same triangle (overlapping faces within 64 ulp of t are counted as near ties); bits are reported. Needs the scene assets unless ?scene=none.
